lines: Over the head of this wounded world
darkness leans down heavy
inside a time that won't wake
sorrow chases us without end
and still the sky searches for daybreak
a future we go to take
we are neither weak nor fleeting
believing, loving, burning out as we go
again and again, souls that bleed
beyond the dreams they dream
shining, shining, a new morning comes
toward where hope hangs suspended
toward the dawn that calls to you
Do we fall by losing
or do we chase the light
scattered along the road we chose
tears and wounds grow distant
holding my breath, scorched by the shadows of memory
and still, vivid, cutting through the wind
a future we go to win
passion will always become a torch
raising a signal fire: climb high into the sky
become the wind, bloom, strum the soul
to the place we hurry toward
brightening, brightening, a new morning comes
toward where light hangs suspended
to the far side of the night
the palm that could never reach
a voice holds it up for me
somewhere along the way, this much
it had been echoing
I prayed there be light where you are going
for the sake of every heart
again and again, souls that bleed
beyond the dreams they dream
shining, shining, a new morning comes
a song about to begin
toward the dawn that calls to you
Over the head of this wounded world...
